answer: AMD reported 61,754 metric tCO2e in the 2020 base year and 44,190 metric tCO2e in 2024, approximately 28% lower. Its 2030 target is 30,877 metric tCO2e, a 50% reduction, and the Scope 1 and 2 values and percentage completion received limited-level assurance under ISAE 3000 Revised.
subject: AMD

evidence.quote: In 2024, we achieved a 28% reduction in operating emissions (market-based) compared to our 2020 base year.
